About Us

A Century of Faith,
Power & Revival

Christ Apostolic Church (CAC) is a Pentecostal denomination rooted in the Holy Spirit revival movement of the early 20th century in Nigeria. Born out of divine visitation and apostolic power, CAC has grown to become one of Africa's most influential gospel churches.

We are a people built on prayer, the Word of God, and miraculous signs — proclaiming Jesus Christ as Lord and Saviour to every generation.

  • Prayer & Intercession
  • Holy Spirit Revival
  • Biblical Soundness
  • Community & Care
  • Evangelism
  • Discipleship

Leadership

Our Shepherd

Presiding Pastor · Christ Apostolic Church

A man of God called, anointed, and set apart for this generation. Under his leadership, our congregation has experienced unprecedented growth in faith, numbers, and spiritual impact across communities and nations.

His ministry is marked by uncompromising biblical preaching, fervent prayer, and a deep passion for souls — walking in the apostolic tradition that has defined CAC since its founding.

"The altar of God is the place where heaven meets earth — come with faith and leave transformed."
